pathway_activity.decoder_text: Routing through the first layer is gated by the sign of x3. On the three samples where x3 is negative, every one of the fourteen units returns exactly zero; on the four samples with positive x3 the layer opens broadly, with each unit active on most of them. On the open side the response grows with how far x3 sits above zero: the sample with the largest x3 drives the strongest activity across the layer and the one just above the boundary the weakest.
